Dalton Street, Claremorris, Co. Mayo

Prime Town Centre Investment Opportunity

2 Residential Apartments – "Swallows Nest"

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are delighted to present this excellent investment opportunity located on Dalton Street, Claremorris, Co. Mayo.

Positioned in the heart of Claremorris Town Centre, these two self-contained apartments offer an ideal opportunity for investors or those seeking a mixed-use property in one of Mayo's most sought-after locations.

The apartments have recently become vacant following long-term tenancies and are ready for new owners.

• Bathroom with shower
• Enclosed rear yard

First Floor Apartment

Features

• Two self-contained apartments

• Previously approved for Housing Assistance Payment (HAP)
• Excellent investment potential
• Walking distance to all shops, schools, cafés and local amenities
